_note: The KiwiSpec service (docs/kiwispec.md), on the control computer:
python -m robofast.devices.kiwispec_service --config sites/minerva/kiwispec.example.json
Addresses are 127.0.0.1 placeholders; ports are the legacy servers' (spectrograph.ini SERVER_PORT, CAMERA_PORT).
allow_hardware false: see docs/kiwispec.md before turning it on.
stage_positions: null -- the iodine stage is moved BY NAME and the live spectrograph_server.ini on the
spectrograph PC is AUTHORITATIVE; the service learns the mm from the server (sites/minerva/README.md). Set
stage_positions only as a cross-check, with values CONFIRMED ON THE SPECTROGRAPH PC before hardware use.
heater_setpoint, heater_tolerance: spectrograph.ini I2SETTEMP, I2TEMPTOL. ccd_format, readout_mode:
spectrograph.ini [SI_SETTINGS]. telescopes: all four feed the fiber at the same time (one spectrum, up to
four telescopes; T3 and T4 are down with Aqawan 2).
flux_source fau: the legacy exposure meter (PMT) is not used; the flux record is each telescope's FAU guide
frames (the counts inside the fiber's footprint, reported by its guider's flux_report), summed. Exposures
run their fixed time unless target_counts is given (then in these relative FAU units). docs/kiwispec.md.
pressure_alarm warning: the spectrograph is isolated from its pump for now (pump side at atmosphere), so a
pressure above max_spec_pressure (legacy 0.006 mbar) warns instead of marking the spectrograph down.
pc_utc_offset_hours -7: the spectrograph PC keeps MST without daylight saving.
raw_fits: the spectrograph PC's data directory as mounted on this host (legacy fix_fits read
/Data/kiwispec/<night>); each raw file is made legal FITS in place, verified. Confirm the mount first.
camera_restart: SI Image is killed and restarted at once after 2 camera failures in a row (the CCD cooler
stops while it is down). chiller: the Oasis 3 is telemetry only and has no driver yet; set
{"kind": "oasis3"} to show it as missing in /status.
Calibration (JDE 2026-10-31): KiwiSpec is iodine only -- 'There are no ThAr lamps or a way to robotically
switch over. It's all iodine.' lamp_frames is empty, so ThAr and fiber-flat frames are refused.
slit_flat_led false: slit flats are refused (legacy stopped them in 2023, 'Slit flat lamp is dead');
set it true only once the LED is confirmed working. The calibration plan: docs/kiwispec.md, Calibration.
ccd_setpoint -80, ccd_operational_temp -75 (JDE 2026-11-05; the cooler cannot reach the old -90 with the
current coolant): sent to the camera's RAM at every connection; the refuse-to-expose window is -95..-78.
backlight false: the backlight's servo stopped answering (2026-11); the guiders use the fiber positions in
their configs, and the service sends no backlight command.
